index.title: Contests
index.lead: Find, filter and open the contests you manage.

list.searchLabel: Search by contest key or name

bulk.showBody: The contests appear to everyone allowed to see them. Showing a public contest needs the visibility permission.
bulk.hideBody: The contests leave the lists and public pages; only their editors still see them. You can show them again at any time.

errors.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
errors.ratingRange: The maximum rating cannot be below the minimum.
errors.penalty: Enter a whole number, not negative.
errors.imageUrl: Use an http(s) address or a path starting with /, at most 150 characters.
errors.key: The key may only hold lowercase letters, digits and underscores, 1 to 32 characters.
errors.name: The contest name must be 1 to 100 characters.

fields.name: Contest name
fields.disallowVirtualHint: On: nobody can take the contest virtually after it ends.
fields.formatConfigNote: Fields depend on the format; changing the format restores that format's defaults.
fields.showSubmissionListHint: Contestants see every submission and the stats during the contest (they must be able to see the ranking).
fields.pushLabel: Also push over the live channel
fields.pushHint: New announcements are also pushed to participants who have the contest open.
fields.rateAllHint: Off: rate only those who registered.
fields.runPretestsOnlyHint: Only pretests run during the contest; full tests at final judging.
fields.hideProblemTagsHint: Contestants do not see the problem tags.
fields.isOrganizationPrivateHint: Only members of the chosen organizations may enter.

hints.timeLimit: Leave empty if everyone takes the contest in the same window.
hints.scoreboardCacheTimeout: 0 turns the cache off. At most 86400.
hints.accessCodeSet: A code is set (stored hashed). Type a new one to replace it; leave empty to keep it.
hints.accessCodeNone: No code yet. Type one to set it.
hints.rankingCodeSet: A code is set. Type a new one to replace it; leave empty to keep it.
hints.ogImage: Shown when the contest link is shared (Discord, Facebook). An http(s) address or a path starting with /. Empty: the site image.
hints.logoOverrideImage: Shown beside the contest name at the top of the contest page. An http(s) address or a path starting with /. Empty: no logo.
hints.lockedAfter: Submissions after this time are not rejudged.

general.tagPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter

sectionLeads.info: The name, description and tags shown on the contest page.
sectionLeads.people: Who sets, curates and tests. Each may edit the contest by role.
sectionLeads.time: Every time is in Vietnam time (UTC+7).
sectionLeads.access: Who sees the contest, who may enter and who sees the scoreboard.
sectionLeads.rating: Whether the contest is rated, and for whom.
sectionLeads.operations: The rules shown to contestants, and balloons.

visibility.label: Visible
visibility.offState: Hidden — participants cannot see it yet

leads.info: The key is used in the contest page address.
leads.access: Who sees the scoreboard. Show or hide the contest with the Visible switch in the summary.

basic.quickHint: Sets the end from the start.

formats.ioi: Partial points per test; the best submission counts.
formats.icpc: Whole problem right or wrong; ranked by solved count and penalty time.
formats.default: Adds the best score of each problem; ties go to who finished first.

basic.otherFormat: This contest uses the {format} format. Pick another format on the Advanced tab.
basic.moreFormats: VNOJ, IOI 2016, Ultimate, Final submission and the format settings are on the Advanced tab.

create.title: Create contest
create.lead: Fill in the details and the times; everything else can be changed later. Next: add problems.

problems.addPlaceholder: Add a problem: type a code or name, Enter adds the exact code
problems.alreadyListed: Problem {code} is already in the contest.
problems.orderLine: The table order is the contest order (at most 100 problems). Type a new position or use the up and down buttons to change it.
problems.prefixLine: Output cut: leave empty for the judge's default.
problems.limitsLine: No problem has an output cut or a submission cap.
problems.rescoreWarning: Changing points or scoring after submissions exist does not rescore them automatically.
problems.rescoreLink: Use Rescore on the Actions tab.
problems.pointsRange: Points from 0 to 3500, a whole number.
problems.addHint: Type to search codes and names, then pick; Enter adds the exact code typed.
problems.copied: Added {added} problems from {key} ({skipped} skipped); save to keep them.
problems.empty: No problems yet. Add one in the box above.

announcements.pushOn: Also pushed over the live channel.
announcements.pushOff: Not pushed over the live channel. Turn it on in the General tab.
announcements.deleteBody: Participants will no longer see this announcement.
announcements.titleError: The title must be 1 to 100 characters.

official.title: Official ranking
official.lead: Upload the official scoreboard the organisers settled after review. It shows next to the automatic ranking and replaces it when published.
official.urlLabel: https link to the CSV file
official.removeBody: The automatic ranking shows again for everyone.

link.title: Public ranking link
link.none: No link yet? Press Create link to make a new URL; the starting state follows the contest settings.
link.activeLine: The link is active. Anyone with the URL can view the ranking without signing in.
link.inactiveLine: The link has expired or is private.
link.regeneratedAt: Regenerated at {time}. Regenerating stops the old URL from working.
link.regenerateBody: The old URL stops working at once.
link.needsAmount: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1 000 000.

preview.M: Expires {amount} minutes after the last regeneration, that is {date} at {time}.
preview.D: Expires {amount} days after the last regeneration, that is {date}.

rescore.title: Rescore
rescore.description: Recalculate the score and rank of every participation from the existing submissions. Runs in the background.
rescore.confirmBody: The score and rank of {count} participations will be recalculated from the submissions. The ranking may change while it runs.

judgeFinal.title: Final judging
judgeFinal.description: For the final-submission format: queue the pending submissions for judging when the contest ends. Runs in the background.
judgeFinal.unavailable: Only for the final-submission format, once the contest has started.
judgeFinal.confirmBody: The pending submissions will be queued for judging.
judgeFinal.earlyWarning: The contest has not ended: contestants see their results at once. Submissions made after this run wait for the end.

rate.title: Rating
rate.description: Update the participants' ratings from the contest result. Runs in the background.
rate.confirmBody: The ratings of the participants in this contest will be updated. Only do this once the ranking is settled and the official ranking is uploaded.

data.title: Export submissions
data.description: Pack the submitted source code into a zip file.
data.readyDetail: Created at {readyAt}; it can be prepared again after {nextPrepareAt}.
data.notEnded: The export is available after the contest ends.
data.notConfigured: Contest data export is not configured on this server.
data.waitUntil: It can be prepared again after {time}.
data.globHint: * stands for any run of characters, ? for one character.

clone.title: Clone the contest
clone.description: Create a new contest with the same problems and settings, without participants.
clone.endLine: Ends {time}, as long as the original.

participants.countSplit: {total} participations, of which {live} participants and {virtual} virtual · 50 per page
participants.disqualifyBody: {kind} at {time} will be marked disqualified and taken off the ranking. It can be restored at any time.
participants.restoreBody: {kind} at {time} returns to the board, the contest ban is lifted and the ranking is recomputed.
participants.footnote: Disqualified users still see their own submissions, but are taken off the ranking.

bulk.disqualifyBody: Each contestant is banned from the contest and moved out of it; the ranking is recomputed once.
bulk.reinstateBody: The contestants return to the board and their contest ban is lifted; the ranking is recomputed once.

reasons.forbidden: You lack the right for this contest.
reasons.not_found: Not found (or not yours to edit).
reasons.conflict: The contest changed meanwhile; try again.
